fixtures.note: Design fixtures only. Uploads are local previews and never committed or included in URLs. Test the same composition with a real photo and transparent illustration.

cover-copy-space-v1.contract: Explicit copy allocation: preserve v4 lower image reservation or use expanded height. Asset state never selects copy allocation. Overlap is diagnostic only.

cover-stable-graphics-v2.contract: Main and optional additional graphic preserve independent uploads and intrinsic aspect ratios. Four corner anchors are available. Copy uses the source lower-zone reservation across empty/loading/loaded/removed states. Pixel overlap is diagnostic only, never a headline-fit input.

curated-complete-copy-fit-v1.contract: Measure hook/detail/complete metadata with their visible typography. Reserve their actual height before fitting the title. Retain every field; warn on minimum-size or whole-copy overflow.

curated-copy-density-v1.contract: Fit and visual density are separate: more than 7 copy lines or more than 3 title lines warns, while every field remains visible.

curated-copy-hierarchy-v1.contract: Headline dominant; hook36/600; detail30/500; suburb and price28/600. Supporting and metadata roles have bounded minimum sizes; overflow warns.

curated-copy-protection-v2.contract: Feathered background-colour scrim follows actual copy top/bottom and horizontal bounds with modest padding. Image remains full-colour outside this local region. No pixel analysis or asset measurements drive copy fitting.

curated-independent-number-scale-v1.contract: Fit only the title with loaded real-font metrics. Plain number reuses the resulting display font family, font size, weight, tracking and line height in its original 72/96px centred anchor. Number does not add a title line or reduce headline fitting capacity.

curated-number-options-v4.contract: Plain, pill and circle keep original composition-owned number anchors. Plain is not part of the title or copy stack. None releases number spacing and colour choices remain.

curated-optional-price-v1.contract: Empty or hidden price reserves no space. Plain price or filled tag aligns to the chosen copy edge. Reserve exact variant metadata height before fitting headline.

curated-strong-metadata-v1.contract: Measure the suburb and price independently at matching 42px target support typography; use a high-contrast price tag. Reserve actual metadata-row height before title fitting.

curated-two-compositions-v1.contract: Visual-above panel remains available; visual-below has dominant upper copy and bottom-anchored composed artwork. Neither medium nor load state selects layout. Frame fitting preserves natural aspect ratio/transparency.

list-exclusive-footer-v1.contract: The chosen footer is CTA, graphic or none. An inactive uploaded graphic cannot reserve space or overlap a CTA. If minimum-scale rows do not fit, report overflow and do not silently clip them at the list zone.

list-headline-budget-v1.contract: Measure the same list rows at the minimum allowed scale with loaded fonts. Allocate headline height from real remaining geometry; this capacity is shared across size intents. Items follow measured header height.

list-readable-third-v2.contract: Retain strong 600/.95 third line but use 29/26/23 base sizes below secondary34/30/27. Every count/column/fit scale must keep primary > secondary > third.

list-strong-type-v1.contract: Item weights 700/900; number weight 900 with stronger numerals. Plain numbers use the foreground on light palettes for legibility.

lovable-restored-layout-v1.contract: Preserve source composition from ec495d3; image and numbering choices remain bounded.

restored-list-content-fit-v1.contract: Source count/density/column metrics, 0.8 floor and per-item line warnings.

restored-list-header-connected-v1.contract: Source header-connected layout, footer and actual motif safety.

restored-monotonic-headline-v1.contract: Identical geometry and shared typography fit capacity across all size intents; Large >= Default >= Small.

restored-real-font-measurement-v1.contract: Bundled real fonts, exact rendered typography, explicit font readiness before fitting.

restored-split-shared-headline-v1.contract: One headline size for both Split panels; natural wraps and separate supporting-copy fit.
